name: Xerox zine
region: London, New York and every town with a copy shop
summary: A fanzine made with scissors, glue, a typewriter and a photocopier, in black toner on white office paper. Sniffin' Glue started in London in 1976; punk, hardcore and riot grrrl made the copy shop a press anyone could use.

philosophy.core_thesis: If a copier is the press, anyone can publish, and the rough marks of the copy are proof of independence.
design_principles: Paste up each page by hand from typewriter text, hand lettering, letters cut from magazines and photos.
Copy in black toner only; push the contrast until the photos are black shapes and the greys drop out.
Let pieces sit at angles; show the edges of the cut paper and the tape.
Copy a copy to add grain, toner noise and a black edge round the page.
Fold A4 or letter sheets in half and staple them at the fold.
anti_patterns: Clean, aligned typesetting on a grid
Full colour or a smooth grey tone
A polished logo or a corporate look

process.matrix: A paste-up master of cut paper on a sheet; no plate.
process.press: An office photocopier with dry toner, fused by heat.
process.image_making: The editor writes, cuts, pastes and copies, often at night in a copy shop or an office.
process.edition: 50–5,000 copies, printed as the money comes.

inks.strategy: One black toner; colour, if any, from a coloured paper or a marker.

screening.rule: Let the copier turn the greys into a coarse, random toner grain or drop them to white.

registration.rule: One pass of toner; the paste-up can be crooked, but there is no register.

substrate.stock: White or coloured office paper, A4 or US letter.

surface.impression: No bite; the toner sits on the surface with a slight gloss.
surface.sheen: A faint gloss in the solid blacks of toner.
surface.texture: Hard black and white, with toner specks, streaks and the shadows of the cut paper.

emotion.target_response: Raw urgency: the reader feels anger, humour and a voice that nobody edited.

avoid_when: The brand must look trusted or premium.
The reader needs long, clear text.

modifiers.how: Keep the paste-up, but print it on a riso with 2–3 spot inks.
Use the web style of the punk zine: torn edges, cut-out type and a black and white palette.
